title: Solving Mysteries at the Poirot Café
subtitle_source: subs_resolved/0885.txt, subs_resolved/0886.txt (787 dialogue lines, full transcript read)
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Heiji, Kazuha, Ran, and Amuro under his alias 'Wada Shinichi') omitted by convention. case_type: attempted_murder. The old low-fidelity case file's culprit (Meisuke Ozumi), victim (Tengo Anzai), and core trick (peephole tape + toilet-paper-tube blood shield) all held up against the full transcript -- no correction needed there. What was added on rebuild: the accidental (non-malicious) cause of the blackout -- the victim's own laptop cord shorting out an outlet -- modeled as its own object rather than folded into prose; the drama-club rehearsal room as a second location, since Ozumi's opportunity to know the café's exact seating layout came from a stage set the club built there the previous year; Azusa, the café employee who assists the investigation, added as a witness (was_at completeness); the victim's father, an unnamed Diet member, added as a backstory figure since the false motive (Ozumi believing his girlfriend Yui and the victim were secretly a couple, when they were actually the Dietman's two secret children / half-siblings) only makes sense with him in the graph; and the seating-manipulation step (Ozumi reserving the booth seat with his bag to force Yui there and the victim into the blind-spot chair) made explicit as its own edge instead of buried in the stabbing description.
